season.method: 10,000 seasons. Each run nudges every team's rating by a random amount (up to about 3.0 points a game, shrinking toward Selection Sunday), plays every team's real remaining schedule at its real venues (a league whose schedule isn't posted yet draws random league opponents instead), then an eight-team conference tournament for the automatic bid. The other 44 spots go to the best selection scores left: rating plus Wins Above Bubble (each result minus the chance a bubble team would have won the same game, the résumé number on the committee's team sheets), the 12 weakest automatic qualifiers and 12 weakest at-large teams play in the Opening Round, seeds follow the S-curve, and the 76-team tournament is played out on neutral courts.

naismith.award: Jersey Mike's Naismith Trophy Men's College Player of the Year
naismith.note: Players can play their way onto and off the list during the season. Update this file when the Atlanta Tipoff Club publishes a new list (midseason Top 30, late-season Top 10, semifinalists, finalists).
naismith.method: Ladder score = 60% production (Game Score per game, which credits points, efficient shooting, rebounds, assists, steals and blocks and charges missed shots, turnovers and fouls, as a z-score), 30% team strength (Haslametrics efficiency margin) and 10% NBA Big Board stock. It is the hub's estimate, not voting.
